text.p: Urohealth Systems Inc said Thursday it acquired Microsurge Inc, a privately held medical device company located in Needham, Mass., in a transaction valued at $38 million.
The total consideration was approximately $29 million of Urohealth common stock and the assumption of $9 million of debt.
Additional terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Separately, Urohealth agreed to give health care alliance enterprise Premier Inc's physician groups, outpatient clinics and other alternate sites access to Urohealth's products.
While no minimum purchasing requirements are included in the deal, the five-year agreement has purchasing targets of more than $1 billion over its term, Urohealth said.
Urohealth designs manufacures and markets disease-specific urological, gynecological and general surgery medical products.
